props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, nearest the trigger (or first around the arc) first.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trigger glyph. Turned while open, so a plus becomes a cross.

props.name: layout
props.description: `arc` fans the actions around the trigger; `stack` lines them up as a floating action button’s speed dial.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way a stack fans out. Ignored by the arc.

props.name: labels
props.description: `visible` prints each label beside its action; `hover` shows it on hover and focus only. Defaults to `visible` for a stack and `hover` for an arc.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the centre to each action on the arc, in pixels.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Degrees. 0 points right, -90 points up. Arc only.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Degrees the arc is spread across. 360 makes a full wheel.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when it opens or closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the root, last, so it wins. Position a stack here — `fixed bottom-6 right-6`.
